[bin] fold_bin_op
arm "+" => Some(a.wrapping_add(b))
arm "-" => Some(a.wrapping_sub(b))
arm "*" => Some(a.wrapping_mul(b))
arm "/" if b != 0 && !(a == i64::MIN && b == -1) => Some(a / b)
arm "%" if b != 0 && !(a == i64::MIN && b == -1) => Some(a % b)
arm "&" => Some(a & b)
arm "|" => Some(a | b)
arm "^" => Some(a ^ b)
arm ">>" => Some(a.wrapping_shr(b as u32))
arm "<<" => Some(a.wrapping_shl(b as u32))
arm "&&" => Some(((a != 0) && (b != 0)) as i64)
arm "||" => Some(((a != 0) || (b != 0)) as i64)
arm "**" if b >= 0 => Some(pow_wrapping(a, b))

[un] fold_un_op
arm "-" => Some(a.wrapping_neg())
arm "+" => Some(a)
arm "!" => Some((a == 0) as i64)
arm "~" => Some(!a)

[model] op -> arm (presence checked)
op + -> Op::Add: present
op - -> Op::Sub: present
op * -> Op::Mul: present
op / -> Op::Div: present
op % -> Op::Mod: present
op & -> Op::BitAnd: present
op | -> Op::BitOr: present
op ^ -> Op::BitXor: present
op >> -> Op::Shr: present
op << -> Op::Shl: present
op && -> Op::And: present
op || -> Op::Or: present
op ** -> Op::Pow: present
guard pow_wrapping squaring shape: PRESENT
guard fold_arith_ast cond recursion: PRESENT
